content.title: The Blackwell Companion to Natural Theology
content.author: William Lane Craig and J. P. Moreland, editors (Chichester: Wiley-Blackwell, 2009)
content.note: A collection of long essays, one for each main argument for God's existence, by Christian philosophers. Cited as a whole; chapter authors are not named because no copy was checked. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
